title: RECRUITMENT TEST EXAMINATION DATE FOR THE POST OF RESEARCH OFFICER (RO)
text:

9ARUNACHAL PRADESH

ITANAGAR
No. PSC-R(B)L6/2020 Dated ltanagar, the L5th )uly' 2O2t
With reference to Commission advertisement NO. PSC-R(B)/16/2021Dated 22nd
Sept 2020 , it is to inform all the eligible candidates that Commission has fixed the date for
conducting of Recruitment Test for the post of Research Officer on 5th Sept 2021. The
Recruitment Test (Objective Type) will be on General English and General Knowledge of 100
marks each . Duration of examination will be of 2 (two) hours.
The venue of examination Centers will be intimated in due course.
